title: The Signature Career Qualification Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Qualifications and education commonly required for specific careers. The Career Qualification Database maps careers to the qualifications employers commonly require: degrees, certifications, experience levels, and skill sets, drawn from published job postings and professional standards. Each career record shows multiple entry paths, not just one. The Signature side adds gap analyzers comparing a student's current qualifications to a target career.
capabilities: Map careers to required degrees, certifications, and skills
Show multiple entry paths per career
Analyze qualification gaps against target careers
Base requirements on published postings and standards
Track how requirements shift over time

title: The Signature Career Qualification Database — Connection layer: public to Signature record mapping
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. The connection layer links records across both sides. Public record JAH-CDB-CAREERQU-NNNNNN maps to Signature record JAH-CDBS-CAREERQU-NNNNNN by shared record number; provenance is tracked per record and never mixed. The student AI searches both sides through this mapping.
